description: This is a C source file implementing memory testing functions, including address validation, random fill, pattern fill, comparison, and interactive testing routines for memory diagnostics.

methods.name: memtest_progress_start
methods.description: Initializes and displays the start of a memory test progress bar with a title and pass number.

methods.name: memtest_progress_end
methods.description: Clears the screen at the end of a progress display.

methods.name: memtest_progress_step
methods.description: Updates the progress bar with the current progress based on the memory test's current position.

methods.name: memtest_addressing
methods.description: Tests memory addressing by populating each location with its own address and verifying correctness.

methods.name: memtest_fill_random
methods.description: Fills memory with pseudo-random data using a custom PRNG.

methods.name: memtest_fill_value
methods.description: Fills memory with two alternating values.

methods.name: memtest_compare
methods.description: Checks memory for consistency between paired locations.

methods.name: memtest_compare_times
methods.description: Repeats memory comparison multiple times to detect errors.

methods.name: memtest_test
methods.description: Performs comprehensive memory tests including addressing, random, solid, and checkerboard patterns.

methods.name: memtest_preserving_test
methods.description: Memory test that preserves original memory content by backing up and restoring data.

methods.name: memtest_alloc_and_test
methods.description: Allocates specified memory size and runs tests on it.

methods.name: memtest
methods.description: Main function to run memory tests on a specified amount of megabytes.
